claim: The AI 2040 project published supplementary materials to accompany a scenario they wrote.
context: We thought about many things in order to write this scenario. We believe in transparency, so we're publishing our thinking here in the form of various supplements, even though some of them are unpolished, scrappy, and/or guesswork.
